headline: Sales held near $15,800 in August, but higher labor produced a small loss for the month
model_notes: August sales were $15,755, down from $18,012 in July
Net operating income was a loss of $568, the first negative month since January
Labor was 52.5% of sales against a 35% target, with training and coverage shifts added in the month
Year to date through August the cafe has earned $4,218 on $125,672 of sales
outlook: The model projects a return to profit in September at roughly $1,070 on $16,400 of sales
Full year 2026 is projected at about $8,000 of net operating income on $186,600 of sales
The slower holiday months (November through January) remain the main risk to that figure
